name: Geoffrey Litster
role: Dyer/weaver; leader of the Norfolk rising
description: A dyer (his surname derives from the trade) who led the rebellion in Norfolk, gathering forces outside Norwich around 17 June 1381. His rising was defeated by Henry Despenser, Bishop of Norwich, at the Battle of North Walsham on or around 25-26 June 1381; Litster was captured and executed, reportedly by Despenser's own order, without royal commission.
narrative_function: Leads the largest and last major regional rising to be suppressed by force rather than by negotiation or attrition.
